title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened Angola's climate resilience by providing technical assistance for the development of the child-friendly Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0 and Angola's first National Adaptation Plan, ensuring youth participation. UNICEF also advanced groundwater research with deep-borehole drilling to increase knowledge and provide strategic data for future access to climate-resilient water.
